text:
sam: Nimbus pilot ask: predictable monthly spend + safe ramp.
anya: Finance wants floors. Propose 3-month ramp: month1 30% commit, month2 60%, month3 100% or walk. Need numbers.
mike: For Performance commit we need reserved pool. That implies placement fee or higher commit.
liz: Sales asks for simple customer-facing SKU + per-seat option. Also audit retention add-on request.
sam: Proposed numbers:
```
Ramp Pilot (12 weeks):
- Month1: 30% commit, $4k floor, soft burst credits (up to 1.5x)
- Month2: 60% commit, $10k floor, reserved burst window
- Month3: 100% commit, $22k min to convert to Performance
Add-ons:
- Dedicated pool: +$7k/mo
- Extended retention: +$900/mo/TB
- Per-seat admin: $18/seat/mo (cap applies)
SLA: 99.9% post-conversion. Pilot: expected SLOs documented but no contractual SLA.
Pilot credit: $3k usage credit applied.
```
anya: Finance ok with $4k floor if signed conversion or auto-convert after month3. Otherwise require higher floor.
pricing-bot: Estimate: dedicated pool increases infra cost ~28%; pilot credits reduce margin ~5% first year.
mike: I'll draft runbook with rollback: throttle non-critical routes when error budget >4% and auto-downgrade if burst >x for >10m. ETA 24h.
sam: Action items: @anya confirm floors, @mike publish runbook, @liz create one-pager. I'll present to Nimbus tomorrow.
liz: Will deliver one-pager by EOD. :thumbsup:
